_comment: Single source of truth for the harness's knobs. Read by the Node scripts in scripts/*.mjs and by the Playwright specs in ../e2e/*.ts. It is JSON rather than a shared module because those two run under different loaders: Playwright transpiles .ts through its own pipeline and cannot import an ESM .mjs from this CommonJS package. Every value can be overridden by the matching env var listed below.
_syncableComment: The second seeded movie. Unlike Sample Clip - whose audio the VAD reads as ~92% speech, leaving nothing to correlate against - this one has a deliberate speech/silence pattern and its subtitle track is displaced by a known offset, so a sync run over it has a right answer to be checked against. No year in the folder name, unlike Sample Clip (2020): Jellyfin left the year in the resolved item Name for this folder ("Structured Clip (2021)") while stripping it for Sample Clip, and a name that depends on a resolver quirk is not something the specs should look up by. Without a year there is nothing to strip. See test/fixtures/PROVENANCE.md and issue #20.

_env.JELLYFIN_URL: overrides the whole base URL, default http://127.0.0.1:<port>
